title: Meilin Lee — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Meilin Lee — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Turning Red is a 2022 American animated coming-of-age film directed by Domee Shi from a script she wrote with Julia Cho. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, it marks the first Pixar feature film solely directed by a female director.

The psychology underneath Meilin Lee is simpler and older than the story on top. They studied red pandas at the San Francisco Zoo, and looked at architecture in Chinatown in San Francisco and the Bok Kai Temple in Marysville. Domee Shi said that several anime influenced the film, including Doraemon, Sailor Moon, Ranma ½, Fruits Basket, and Inuyasha.
